neutral.changes: 현재 V2 일반대사 디자인과 소품을 보존하며 고해상도 전신 정면시선으로 재제작
neutral.prompt: Edit this exact current game sprite into ONE 1024 x 1536 portrait full-body character on true transparent background, NOT a sheet. Preserve the elderly brown-and-cream anthropomorphic owl grandfather's identity and mature age, tufted horn-like ears, cream face and chest feather beard, thick gray brows, small rectangular gold-rim half glasses, dark hooked beak, golden yellow eyes, olive long coat, rust-red long scarf, cream shirt, brown belt with square gold buckle, charcoal trousers, brown ankle boots and striped tail at image LEFT. Preserve the body stance and hand positions: small pencil held at image LEFT hand and open small brown notebook supported by image RIGHT hand at chest. Only turn the head and eyes enough to address the viewer/father straight on: BOTH eyes visible, pupils centered at camera, not lowered toward notebook. Calm neutral attentive expression, with original aged brows retained, not rejuvenated. High-quality faithful chunky pixel game art, thick dark stepped outlines, large solid color areas and 2-3 hard-edged shadow tones. No airbrush, no glossy 3D, no added props. Entire ear tufts, tail, boots and book inside frame with a small clear margin. Fully isolated, NO dark haze, NO glow, NO drop shadow, NO background pixels, NO white border or text. Transparent exterior must be entirely alpha zero.
neutral.visual_review: 정면 양눈·감정 구분·전신/소품 보존 확인; 밝은 배경 투명 가장자리는 root 독립 검수
